designationHistory.indexText: Established in 1977 under the Migratory Bird Conservation Act, along the border of the Mississippi Delta and the loess hills.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Morgan Brake National Wildlife Refuge, established in 1977, encompasses about 7,400 acres in Holmes County along the ecological border between the Mississippi alluvial plain and loessal hills in the biologically and culturally unique Delta region of Mississippi.
